description: Proposed widening of the Spit Bridge over Middle Harbour : statement of environmental effects/review of environmental factors : Vol. 2: appendices D-J is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The RTA proposes to widen the Spit Bridge by providing an additional two lanes for the movement of traffic. This would involve constructing a new two-lane bridge directly abutting the existing bridge to the west, and reconfiguring the lanes on the existing bridge. List of appendices: A. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing).
